title: Griffith Mansion

buildingCutout.basis: The approximate house-wall envelope reconstructed from the georeferenced public-domain roof and dated exterior references.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the central porch approach. The model threshold is estimated from the ground-level exterior.

mapIdentity.provider: USGS and USDA NAIP natural-color orthoimagery. The main roof is identifiable in the government map. OpenStreetMap does not map this mansion’s footprint.

identities.name: Griffith Mansion
identities.method: photo-correlated roof and approach visible in public-domain NAIP, model wall lines estimated from roof and ground photos

mapIdentity.scope: The registered federal NAIP roof and entrance approach establish scale and heading. Cleared front and rear views establish the two projecting bay forms, porch and attached ranges; wall lines are inferred under roof edges and tree cover.

note: Exact June 2009 ground-level originals establish white painted horizontal siding, arched sash, Corinthian porch columns and a deep bracketed eave. Roof and story heights are estimated using windows, doors, columns and the roof footprint.
